tools.name: transcriptlab_get_transcript
tools.description: Get a YouTube transcript. Use when the user gives a YouTube link or video ID and wants the transcript. tools.name: transcriptlab_retrieve_transcript
tools.description: Read a YouTube transcript that is already published for this account, without starting a new fetch. Use it after transcriptlab_get_job_status reports a job done, or to re-open a variant that was delivered before. For a first request use transcriptlab_get_transcript instead. Pass the same engine/tier

tools.name: transcriptlab_discover_captions
tools.description: List the caption languages and track types (manual vs generated) available for a YouTube video. Use when the user asks which languages or subtitles a video has, or before transcriptlab_get_transcript when they want a specific language. Free in transcript credits, but subject to the account monthly d

tools.name: transcriptlab_search_transcript
tools.description: Search, quote, or slice a transcript already delivered to this account. Use for "find the part where...", keyword or regex lookup, or paginating a long transcript into chunks. It never starts a fetch and never charges transcript credits, so it only works on a video already cached here: deliver it fi

tools.name: transcriptlab_get_job_status
tools.description: Check whether a transcript job from transcriptlab_get_transcript has finished. Use it when that tool returned a job_id instead of a transcript. Returns status only, delivers no transcript, and spends no credits; once it reports done, read the text with transcriptlab_retrieve_transcript.

tools.name: transcriptlab_get_usage
tools.description: Read the account plan, remaining credits, and current-period usage, plus upgrade options. Use when the user asks about cost, balance, or limits, or before a credit-spending request.

tools.name: transcriptlab_create_checkout_link
tools.description: Create a hosted Dodo checkout link bound to the user's connected TranscriptLab account (no website sign-in required). tools.name: transcriptlab_list_transcripts
tools.description: List YouTube videos whose transcripts were already delivered to this account, most recent first. Use it to find or reopen an earlier transcript. It fetches nothing and delivers no transcript. When more results exist, page with the returned cursor.

tools.name: transcriptlab_mentions
tools.description: Composer at-mention search over the account’s transcript library, used to build the @TranscriptLab picker. App-facing only: the host calls it, it returns resource links rather than transcript text, and the model should not call it.

tools.name: transcriptlab_open_audio
tools.description: Entry point the host invokes when the user opens an audio or video file with this plugin: opens the uploader view and starts speech-to-text. You do not call this directly; for a file attached to the conversation use transcriptlab_transcribe_file.

tools.name: transcriptlab_begin_audio_upload
tools.description: Create a signed direct-upload session for an opened audio file. App-facing only: the uploader view calls it, not the model.

tools.name: transcriptlab_start_audio_transcription
tools.description: Finalize a signed upload and start speech-to-text on it. App-facing only: the uploader view calls it once the file is uploaded. Spends credits per audio minute.

tools.name: transcriptlab_read_audio_transcript
tools.description: Read the transcript of a file uploaded through the uploader view. A pending transcription reports 202; retry shortly. App-facing only.

tools.name: transcriptlab_open
tools.description: Open the TranscriptLab launcher view, where the user can work with transcripts visually and send one into the chat with "Discuss in chat". Use tab "upload" when a file needs the uploader: the user wants to pick a local audio or video file, the attached file is too large or could not be read by trans

tools.name: transcriptlab_transcribe_file
tools.description: Transcribe an audio or video file the user attached to this conversation, using speech-to-text (mp3, m4a, wav, mp4, webm and similar). tools.name: transcriptlab_export_link
tools.description: Create a 10-minute signed download link (TXT, SRT, VTT, Markdown, or JSON) for a transcript the account already has, or for a transcribed upload. Call this when the user wants a file or a link to a file: hand them the returned url and say it expires in 10 minutes. Needs a signed-in connection. The l

tools.name: transcriptlab_submit_batch
tools.description: Queue a list of YouTube URLs as one batch job and return its job id. App-facing only. The plan caps how many URLs one job accepts.

tools.name: transcriptlab_transcribe_playlist
tools.description: List a YouTube playlist's videos, or list and transcribe all of them, as one asynchronous job. tools.name: transcriptlab_list_job_items
tools.description: Return per-video results for a batch, channel or playlist job. Page with the returned cursor.

findings.name: transcriptlab_search_videos
findings.description: Search videos on YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram with optional YouTube filters (upload_date, duration, sort, captions). Searching costs 0 credits. Optionally set transcripts=true to expand up to 10 videos inline (billed at normal transcript credits per delivered video).

findings.name: transcriptlab_search_channels
findings.description: Search channels or creators on YouTube or Instagram. Costs 0 credits.

findings.name: transcriptlab_list_channel_videos
findings.description: List recent videos, shorts, or streams from a YouTube channel or TikTok/Instagram profile. Listing costs 0 credits; optional transcripts=true expands up to 10 videos inline and bills normal transcript credits per delivered video.

findings.name: transcriptlab_list_monitors
findings.description: List all configured channel/profile monitors on this account (Starter/Pro plan required).

findings.name: transcriptlab_get_new_videos
findings.description: Read newly discovered videos (and optional transcripts) recorded by a channel monitor. Pass since from latest_cursor to poll incrementally.

findings.name: transcriptlab_create_monitor
findings.description: Watch a YouTube channel or TikTok/Instagram profile for new videos (Starter/Pro plan required). Monitor checks cost 0 credits; only newly transcribed videos when transcripts=true bill credits.

findings.name: transcriptlab_check_monitor_now
findings.description: Run an immediate check on a channel monitor and return any newly discovered videos. Costs 0 credits unless transcripts=true delivers new transcripts.

findings.name: transcriptlab_delete_monitor
findings.description: Delete a channel monitor and its recorded event history.
